items.question: Why am I exhausted even after sleeping?
items.answer: There can be several causes — from iron deficiency or thyroid problems to sleep quality and chronic stress. The 6D questionnaire helps map where to look.

items.question: Why are my lab results 'normal' if I feel unwell?
items.answer: Standard tests mainly look for acute pathology. I also look at the functional connections between your symptoms.

items.question: Is the first step paid?
items.answer: No. The 6D questionnaire is free. Based on it you receive a preliminary conclusion and advice on whether to continue.

items.question: How does an online consultation work?
items.answer: The session lasts 60 minutes via Zoom. I review your questionnaire and available results in advance.

items.question: What is 6D Navigation?
items.answer: A comprehensive approach that assesses health in six dimensions — from diagnostics through movement, the nervous system and nutrition to lifestyle.

items.question: How much does a consultation cost?
items.answer: The questionnaire is free. 6D Diagnostics (60 minutes) costs €100.

items.question: Do you offer in-person consultations?
items.answer: Yes, in Piešťany by prior appointment.

items.question: Does this replace my doctor?
items.answer: No. The consultation complements care from your own physician. In an emergency call 112.
